question: Were exactly the failed proof obligations repaired, on exactly the families they failed on?

environment.whyItMatters: the lane preflight gates on rendering and this container cannot bind sources. Every repair here is a non-rendering repair: no ink was added and every fixture PDF is byte-identical to the committed one, recomputed from disk and recorded on its row.

blocker.what: the pinned Master Library is not present and cannot be recovered in this container
blocker.detail: scripts/rcap-corpus/bootstrap-private-corpus.sh resolves the release asset Expungement_AI_RCAP_Master_Library_Edition_1.zip from Roger-LegalEase/legalease-source-artifacts@source-corpus-2026-08-28 and the request answers HTTP 403 to this session token. verify-packet-build-environment.mjs reports PACKET_BUILD_ENVIRONMENT_NOT_READY with family_sources_bind failing, so neither --build nor --check starts for any family and no PDF can be re-rendered.
blocker.consequence: a repair that requires new ink is a rebuild, and no rebuild can run here.

environment.rasterState: BUILT_RASTER_PENDING. Nothing here is self-verified, none is RASTER_PASS, and visualDefects reads zero because nobody has looked.

contractObservation.finding: the completeness contract has no disposition for a companion the packet holds as source evidence and never generates.
contractObservation.detail: PA-IFP-MDJ carries ninety-four terminal fields on a document the participant never receives. The host states this with its own refusal class source_only_not_generated, which is outside the contract's closed refusal vocabulary, so every one of those fields read as an unclassified blank. This lane completed the host's sentence so the contract's approved reason for a field that is never a filing fact matches it, and the disposition it yields, NOT_APPLICABLE_ON_THIS_ROUTE, is the right one. That is a sentence carrying a decision, which is the shape the contract warns about, and it is reported here rather than left to be discovered.
contractObservation.theRealFix: either the host emits no field rows for a non-generated companion, as it already does for NY-CPL-160.59-SEAL-VERIFICATION, or the contract gains a typed class for one. Both are outside this lane's owned paths.

fleetObservation.finding: the west host is ahead of the CA overlays by more than the AZ case showed.
fleetObservation.detail: CA_PRIMARY_WRITES["CR-409"] carries fourteen bound terminal names and ca-851-91's overlay carries four. The petitioner's entire contact block, date of birth, arrest date, citing agency and county are all bound in the host and refused in the overlay. Every CA family will keep failing knownRequiredFieldsMissing and incompleteRows until a rebuild runs.

rows.verdict: BUILT_RASTER_PENDING for the repaired obligations; two obligations returned unrepaired

obligationsRepaired.repair: the same three blanket sentences as ca-1203-42. CR-410 is the court's order front to back and carries court_prosecutor_clerk_or_agency_owned; CR-106 and MC-031 are the participant's own forms and were split by what each blank is, with the proof of service told to wait until service has actually occurred.

the rows carrying "No allowlisted, source-supported fact is offered", which the current host no longer emits, are declared required-before-filing on the contract's channel and disclosed by field name and page in a rewritten participant-instructions.md.
one /Btn control carried "not established by this evidence variant"; it is the petitioner's own mark and now carries participant_sworn_narrative_or_legal_election with isSelectionControl.

all four components are rendered and the record named only the file each was rendered into. reports/rendered-artifacts.json now carries a components array naming each documentId, its form number and role, and the fixture files it was rendered into.

obligationsStopped.whatIsMissing: a rebuild. CA_PRIMARY_WRITES["CR-409"] in the current west host carries fourteen mappings and this overlay's explicitMappingsByVariant carries four. The petitioner's whole contact block, the date of birth, the arrest date, the citing agency and the county are bound to held facts and would be written by a rebuild. They are left exactly as the stale build recorded them rather than reclassified into blanks the participant would be told to fill.

obligationsRepaired.repair: ninety-one of them are on PA-IFP-MDJ, the magisterial-district fee-waiver affidavit, which the field map records as generatedParticipantArtifact false. The participant never receives that document, so no blank on it is a blank on this filing. The host's own class source_only_not_generated is kept and its sentence completed to say so.

the fourth family on the stale untrusted class not_supported_by_exact_participant_fact_map. Fifty-six rows are the host's own required_before_filing determination on the contract's channel, all disclosed by field name and page; one is a certificate-of-service fact conditioned on service having occurred; one is an election.

PA-IFP-MDJ is not a missing companion form; the map records it as not generated. reports/rendered-artifacts.json now carries a componentsNotGenerated array saying so, matching the treatment given NY-CPL-160.59-SEAL-VERIFICATION.

obligationsStopped.whatIsMissing: the petition's charge table. Row 1 carries a written cell beside four blank cells whose printed caption is "Section Subsection Statute Description Counts Grade Disposition". Completing the row means writing those four cells, which needs facts the host does not map and a re-render.
